name: Mockly Multi-Protocol Mock Server
free_limit: MIT-licensed local mock server with HTTP, WebSocket, gRPC, GraphQL, SMTP and other protocol simulation, built-in web UI, scenarios and fault injection; no vendor-enforced usage quota or expiry for the self-run binary.
watch_out: Run the binary or Docker image on your own computer or CI infrastructure; CPU, storage, network and CI runner costs are not included. This is not a free hosted mock-server allocation.
